correctness.rationale: Reconstructed Dirichlet neutrality and conditional regression g(s)=phi(s)+(n-1)E phi((1-s)Y1), with g''(s)>0 for strictly convex C2 phi. After removing affine terms, f(0)=0 and f(s)/s strictly increasing; a size-biased pick W_m~Beta(alpha+1,(m-1)alpha) strictly stochastically decreases with m, forcing g(0)>E F_phi even for n=2. Strict convexity forces g(1)>E F_phi. Since h=g-mean strictly convex, positive at endpoints and mean-zero under Beta(alpha,(n-1)alpha), its negative set is one interval and integrated tail H(t) has exactly one sign crossing from negative to positive. Independently differentiated the proposed beta-tail antiderivative for phi(s)=s^2, confirming Cov(K_t,Q)=n t^alpha(1-t)^beta[((n alpha+2)t-(alpha+1))]/[B(alpha,beta)(beta+1)(n alpha+1)]; sole root (alpha+1)/(n alpha+2), n=2 identically 1/2 and n>2 strictly decreases with alpha. Finite rational examples corroborate but do not prove all real alpha.

value.rationale: Threshold exceedance counts and convex concentration statistics are natural shape diagnostics of random compositions and spacings; the exact covariance sign classification shows when high occupancy predicts positive versus negative concentration and how the transition shifts continuously with Dirichlet shape. It extends the published alpha=1 case to the full natural symmetric Dirichlet parameter family and all strictly convex scores.
